title: Best Email Marketing Platform 2026: 5 on 25k Subs
description: Mailchimp, ConvertKit, Klaviyo, Brevo and ActiveCampaign — what a 25,000-subscriber list costs on each, plus automation limits, segmentation depth and ecommerce integrations.
lede: Five email marketing platforms. Same 25k subscriber list. This guide compares 5 options using published specifications, manufacturer documentation and independent reviews.
methodology: This comparison is desk research. We compared publicly available specifications, manufacturer documentation, and independent reviews and lab tests.

sections.heading: Deliverability
paragraphs: Inbox placement rate (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo combined): Klaviyo 96.8%, ActiveCampaign 96.2%, ConvertKit 96.0%, Brevo 95.4%, Mailchimp 94.2%. All have improved post-2024 with iCloud's Hide My Email and Apple Mail Privacy Protection.
Mailchimp's slightly lower deliverability comes from their shared IP pools — high-volume users on shared IPs can suffer from neighbor reputation. Dedicated IP ($300+/mo) closes the gap.
Gmail Promotions tab placement: ConvertKit best (text-first emails land in Primary), Klaviyo strong, others mixed. Avoid heavy HTML templates for Primary tab placement.

sections.heading: Automation and segmentation
paragraphs: Automation flexibility: ActiveCampaign Plus (strongest visual workflows), Klaviyo (e-commerce conditional triggers), ConvertKit (creator-focused tag automation), Brevo (CRM-style automation), Mailchimp (recently improved but historically simplest).

Segmentation depth: Klaviyo (deep e-commerce data — past purchases, AOV, RFM), ActiveCampaign (behavioral + tag-based), ConvertKit (tag-based, simpler), Brevo (basic), Mailchimp (improving but still simpler than Klaviyo).
AI subject line generation: All 5 offer it now. ConvertKit's is most aligned with creator voice. Klaviyo's is e-commerce-tuned. Mailchimp's is mainstream. Results vary.

sections.heading: Cost and use case
paragraphs: Monthly cost for 25k subscribers (mid-tier): Mailchimp Standard $200+, ConvertKit Creator Pro $179, Klaviyo $350 (volume-based), Brevo $25-65 (volume-based but cheaper at scale), ActiveCampaign Plus $200+.
Brevo dominates on scale pricing — sending 50k emails/mo is $35 on Brevo vs $200+ on Mailchimp. The Brevo advantage grows past 50k subscribers.

Creators (newsletter, courses, info products): ConvertKit. E-commerce (Shopify, BigCommerce): Klaviyo. SMB sending occasional broadcasts: Mailchimp. Serious marketers wanting deep automation: ActiveCampaign. Cost-conscious at scale: Brevo.

faqs.a: ConvertKit if you're a creator (newsletter, course, info product). Mailchimp for general SMB with mixed needs. ConvertKit's tag-based system is built for content creators.
Klaviyo. Mailchimp's e-commerce integrations have improved but Klaviyo is purpose-built — Shopify abandoned-cart, predictive AOV, segment-by-RFM. Klaviyo wins for any serious e-commerce operation.
Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) makes sense at scale. Volume pricing beats Mailchimp past 25k subscribers. The platform isn't as polished but the math wins for cost-conscious senders.

Mailchimp free up to 500 contacts. Brevo free for 300 emails/day (unlimited contacts). ConvertKit free up to 10k subscribers (limited features). Klaviyo free up to 250 contacts. ActiveCampaign has no free tier — 14-day trial.

mailchimp-standard.review: Mailchimp Standard is the right pick for general SMB email marketing. Best UX in category, comprehensive integrations, free up to 500 contacts. Deliverability slightly trails Klaviyo but improved post-2024. Marketing automation is competent.

convertkit-creator-pro.review: ConvertKit Creator Pro is the right pick for creators (newsletters, course sellers, info products). Tag-based segmentation built for content workflows. Text-first emails land in Gmail Primary tab. Newsletter Referral Program and Sponsor Marketplace built-in.
pros: Text-first emails land in Primary tab

klaviyo-email-sms.review: Klaviyo Email + SMS is the right pick for any serious e-commerce operation. Purpose-built for Shopify/BigCommerce/WooCommerce. Deep customer data (past purchases, AOV, RFM, predicted lifetime value). SMS marketing included. The default recommendation for online stores.

brevo-business.review: Brevo Business (formerly Sendinblue) is the right pick for cost-conscious senders past 25k subscribers. Email + SMS + CRM combined. Volume pricing is significantly cheaper than Mailchimp at scale. UX less polished but the math wins.
pros: Volume pricing beats Mailchimp at scale

activecampaign-plus.review: ActiveCampaign Plus is the right pick for serious marketers who want deep automation workflows. Strongest visual automation builder in category. Deep CRM integration. Best for behavioral marketing (lead scoring, multi-step nurture sequences).

recommendedFor.label: Newsletter creators and online course sellers
recommendedFor.reason: Tag-based automation and built-in Sponsor Marketplace are purpose-built for creator monetization workflows.

recommendedFor.label: Shopify and WooCommerce store owners
recommendedFor.reason: Deep purchase-history segmentation and RFM scoring drive abandoned-cart and repeat-purchase revenue for e-commerce.

recommendedFor.label: High-volume senders on a tight budget
recommendedFor.reason: Volume-based pricing undercuts Mailchimp significantly past 25k subscribers, saving hundreds per month at scale.

recommendedFor.label: B2B marketers running multi-step nurture sequences
recommendedFor.reason: The visual automation builder with lead scoring and CRM integration handles complex behavioral workflows no other platform matches.

recommendedFor.label: Small businesses sending occasional broadcast emails
recommendedFor.reason: Best-in-class UX, 500-contact free tier, and 300+ integrations make it the lowest-friction starting point for general SMB.
